messages.text: Can you break down oxidative phosphorylation? I'm lost.
Think of it as a tiny power plant in your cells — glucose is the fuel, and the electron transport chain turns it into usable energy your cells can actually use.

caption:
Stuck on oxidative phosphorylation? Just ask. 🧠

Mora doesn't do flat, one-and-done answers -- you can branch into whatever part actually confused you, and it renders the math and diagrams right there in the chat. No tab-switching to go find a diagram, no scrolling back through a wall of text to find where you got lost.

Ask Mora. Link in bio.
